findings.issue: Inconsistent `@[simp]` across the orthogonality/normal-form family: `trace_spinTensorOperator_spinOneMatrix` (281) and `trace_spinOneMatrix_mul_spinTensorOperator_spinOneMatrix` (343) are tagged, but `trace_spinOneMatrix_mul_spinOneMatrix` (265), `trace_spinTensorOperator_mul_spinTensorOperator_spinOneMatrix` (351), `sum_spinOneMatrix_mul_self` (253) and `sum_spinHalfMatrix_mul_self` (509) are not; likewise `vectorPolarization_spinOneMatrix_single_same` (472) is tagged while `tensorPolarization_spinOneMatrix_single_same` (479) is not.

summary: Bodies are correctly hidden behind `(rfl)` `_def` lemmas and nothing compatibility-only survives, but the characteristic API is incomplete on three points (no hermiticity for `spinHalfMatrix`, no index-uniform vector-polarization entry lemma, no density-matrix property for the extremal state the sharpness lemmas use) and the `@[simp]` tagging of the orthogonality family is inconsistent.
